title: coralRLI: threats, Red List Index and CO₂ responsibility for reef-building corals (data and code)
description: Minimal data and R code to reproduce the three-panel figure on reef-building corals in Yan & Dulvy (2026), Accelerating extinction risk of reef-building corals: (a) the level-1 threats coded for the 892 reef-building coral species, (b) the range-weighted Red List Index by Global Coral Reef Monitoring Network region, built from the back-cast categories of Obura et al. (2026), and (c) each country's share of cumulative CO₂ emissions against its share of the world's reef area. Code is MIT-licensed; summary tables in data/ and the figure in outputs/ are CC BY 4.0. IUCN Red List range polygons and species-level assessment data are not included.
